summary: A 4 CPU, 16 GB control node handles about 10 API requests per second, 137 jobs and 1,100 to 1,630 events per second depending on load; over-provisioning control capacity reduces output delays. The example deploys one execution, one control and one database node and lowers control capacity to 16 to reserve room for event processing.
questions: How many events per second can a control node process?
Why is there a delay before job output appears?
What deployment fits 300 hosts and 10 concurrent jobs?
How do I reserve control node capacity for event processing?
